Samuel Ortiz's birth year will be corrected from 1913 to 1891 based on the 1912 immigration certificate; Leah to share document with Maya for verification
Every genealogy entry will be labeled with its source, and uncertainty notes will be added when the source is only family recollection
Website orientation planned for August 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM to be factored into update planning
